items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Kit CSS, two token sets, fragments, generated examples, build script, token contract, ux-rules, docs and guideline template all exist; Layout D and charts are deliberately excluded and documented.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: build_kit_examples.py --check exits 1 when examples are stale; a missing fragment or token set raises a clear error.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Static CSS/HTML only, no user input, no secrets, no scripts in the examples.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 16 tests in test_untitled_ui_kit.py assert outcomes: tokens-only CSS, every var defined per token set, WCAG contrast pairs computed from the sets, solid hex, font-size floors, examples current, fragment classes defined, contract names all tokens.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Examples are standalone pages of 45-57 KB; no network beyond one font link.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: kit/untitled-ui/{kit.css,tokens,fragments,examples}; kit.css is a single 1110-line stylesheet by design (one SSOT), code files stay under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; examples are a build output checked by --check.
